topic: Calibrating signal strength for demo company
summary_markdown:
The discussion centered on the calibration of signal strength (specifically 60 vs. 89) for a demo company environment, noting that current production data shows significantly lower traffic compared to staging.

Someone suggested that if the calibration level is changed from 60 (current production setting) to 89 (staging/default), the total daily traffic could increase drastically from an estimated 10,000 to 3,500,000. It was confirmed that 89 is the default signal strength.

Later in the session, a concern about residual '60' calibration values appearing for new companies was raised and addressed.
decisions: The signal strength for the demo company will be set to 89 on production, matching the staging environment.
